components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action for moving the current studio task forward.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent-hover); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter alternative for recovery, navigation, or a secondary choice.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #d9c9bd; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--text); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A broad native field with a label and enough height for comfortable Vietnamese input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--text); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #bfaea1; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--text); font: 400 16px/1.65 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #a78c79; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: The three-item creation-first navigation in the product header.
components.html: Tạo videoVideo của bạnThư viện
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--muted); font: 600 14px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Task Panel
components.description: A single white work surface for a focused editing or review task.
components.html:
Đang làm gần đây

Mở lại đúng bài và lượt đã lưu.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #d9c9bd; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--text); } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 17px/1.4 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 16px/1.65 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Notice
components.description: Low-emphasis state copy that explains progress, rights, or the next recovery action.
components.html: Đang chuẩn bị preview.Thiết lập của bạn vẫn được giữ lại.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-notice strong { font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Studio Stepper
components.description: Four real creation steps with the current step made explicit and future work gated honestly.
components.html:
1. 1Nguồn bài
  2. 2Lời đọc
  3. 3Nền & nhạc
  4. 4Xuất video
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9c9bd; list-style: none; color: var(--muted); font: 600 13px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-stepper-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-stepper-item span { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 26px; width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 1px solid #c6b5a8; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 12px; } .ds-stepper-active { color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-stepper-active span { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }

narrative.overview:
Shorts Factory should feel like a calm, friendly workbench for a Vietnamese-speaking creator working locally. The interface starts from the next useful action—bring in a permitted post, review its source images and rights, shape the narration, then render and download an MP4—without making administration compete with creation.

The visual world is warm paper around white working surfaces. Be Vietnam Pro gives Vietnamese labels and longer explanations a human, readable voice; terracotta is reserved for the action that moves the current task forward. A practical preview stays beside the editor on wide screens and moves above the work on small screens. The UI is quiet at rest, explicit about progress and recovery, and honest about review gates and local-only output.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with white, tactile task surfaces.
One clear current task with a useful portrait preview nearby.
Friendly Vietnamese-first typography with comfortable reading rhythm.
Terracotta action color used for decisive movement, not decoration.
Flat tonal depth, gentle borders, and broad accessible controls.

rules.name: The Easy-Path Rule
rules.body: Keep one understandable next action visible for the current task, while preserving access to the source, draft, preview, and recovery state.

rules.name: The Warm-Ground Rule
rules.body: Let warm paper carry the page and white carry the work; do not rebuild the old green palette or make every surface a card.

rules.name: The Clear-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use semibold only to establish hierarchy or action; never turn helper text, progress metadata, or every navigation item into a headline.

rules.name: The Flat-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are calm at rest; use tonal contrast, borders, and explicit state copy before reaching for shadows or decorative chrome.

dos: Do put the next useful action first and keep it visible in the current step.
Do use Be Vietnam Pro and Vietnamese-first labels for creation, capture, review, progress, and recovery.
Do preserve the warm ground, white work surfaces, terracotta action voice, and clay preview layer.
Do keep controls at least 44px high and maintain visible keyboard focus.
Do show original/anonymized source previews, rights review, provenance, and actionable failure states before rendering.
Do keep the editor and preview synchronized as settings change, while requiring a saved script and human review before MP4 approval.
donts: Don't revive the legacy green palette or add decorative badges, ornamental gradients, or nested card scaffolds.
Don't use shadows as the default way to separate content; use tonal surfaces, whitespace, and borders.
Don't hide source integrity, privacy, rights, or recovery details behind ambiguous status language.
Don't claim automatic social publishing; unapproved providers and permissions remain blocked and publishing requires an explicit handoff.
Don't make mobile users lose the preview, the current step, or the recovery action just to save vertical space.
